heading: Friday, July 10, 2026
topLine: OpenAI posts a two-page proof of the cycle double cover conjecture.

items.headline: OpenAI posts a two-page proof of the cycle double cover conjecture
items.summary: OpenAI published a proof, credited to GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra, that every bridgeless graph has a collection of cycles covering each edge exactly twice. Humans wrote the prompt and set up the multi-agent run. Graph theorists Jim Geelen and Sang-il Oum posted expositions on arXiv, and Johannes Carmesin wrote that the proof is correct. Thomas Bloom noted that the core ideas go back to a 1983 paper the proof did not cite. The proof has not been peer reviewed.
